nom: COSRX Low pH Good Morning Gel Cleanser

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers largely report the cleanser removes excess oil without over-stripping, though one oily reviewer says it caused flaking when used both morning and night.
segments.dry: Dry and dry-leaning reviewers are split: several say it leaves skin soft and not stripped, while others report it left skin dry, tight, or flaky, especially with frequent use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers give mixed reports, from praise for gentle, non-stripping cleansing to complaints of stripping, dryness, and breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly describe it as gentle and calming, but a minority report stinging, itching, redness, or breakouts, and fragrance sensitivity is a recurring issue in this group.
segments.normal: The few normal-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as leaving skin clean, soft, and not stripped.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically discuss mature skin.

concerns.aging: No reviewer specifically addresses aging or anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not dry out skin and leaves it soft or hydrated, but a notable minority report dryness, tightness, or flaking, particularly with twice-daily use or in winter.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea-prone skin report mixed results: some say it calmed redness and reduced inflammation, while one with rosacea reports the product caused stinging and visible redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe it as low pH and barrier-friendly, helping skin recover after retinol or chemical irritation; one reviewer used it successfully after a chemical burn from actives.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the cleanser helped reduce blackheads and minimize pores, with several noting improved skin texture and clarity over time.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are strongly divided: many reviewers describe reduced acne, fewer breakouts, and calmer skin over weeks of use, while a substantial group reports new whiteheads, cystic acne, or breakouts starting within days.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers generally report good oil control without excessive stripping, though one reviewer notes it can over-strip oily skin if used both morning and night.

aspects.libelle: Tea tree scent liked once adjusted
Stripping or drying with frequent use

extraits.titre: BEWARE IF YOU DEAL W/ CYSTIC ACNE
extraits.texte: Beware if you have hormonal, cystic, oily/combo/very sensitive skin. Absolutely ruined the progress that was established. Caused my face to be in so much pain and cystic acne to develop. Never dealt w/ white heads before until starting this. Only used it 5 days and was the worst face wash I've ever used in my life

extraits.titre: Caused Me Months of Breakouts + Irritation
extraits.texte: Let me preface this review by stating that I like Corsrx as a brand and have had success with many of their other products in the past. I first tried them out back in 2015 when they were only available for purchase through a few Korean skin care importers such as Soko Glam ect. and thus I felt some level of confidence when picking out this cleanser. I have dry/combination skin that tends to lean on the sensitive side, but nothing about this cleanser gave me any indication that it would irritate my skin. Within a week or so my skin started to feel dry and my overall skin texture started to worsen. I started to get small white heads all over my forehead and hairline, and eventually started to get cystic breakouts on my forehead as well. At the time I attributed this to stress and poor diet, but even after making significant changes in an attempt to improve my skin nothing was changing. I have always had relatively clear skin and when I do breakout it's almost always hormonal and pops up around my period. This was very different. The breakouts were near constant and my skin seemingly worsened no matter what I tried externally or internally. About a week ago I started to really reflect on my routine, products, and any lifestyle changes that could have been causing my breakouts. I was exhausted and frustrated and was even considering seeing a doctor to see if I was suffering from some kind of hormone imbalance. I really wanted to like this cleanser cause I love COSRX, but it just was not what I was expecting at all. I've never used a gel cleanser that foams up before so that was a surprise when I tried it. It also smells AWFUL. I'm so glad I got the sampler kit so I didn't end up with a regular size product that I would feel guilty for not using. It left my skin feeling tight and dry the one time I've used it. I also formed a cystic acne spot which I haven't had in a long time and this was the only new product that could have caused it. I have oily, acne-prone and sensitive skin and COSRX usually does it for me, but this was a major disappointment.

extraits.titre: Don't use this if you have dry skin.
extraits.texte: I actally love the smell of this product. (Tea tree oil). It doesn't bother me but the actual product is incredibly stripping to the skin and I have oily skin which this product got rid of but now my skin is flaky due to the dryness that it has caused. I would recomend this to be used with an oily cleanser and not as a daily morning and night cleanser.

extraits.titre: Doesn't compare to anything else! Love!
extraits.texte: When I first purchased this product I had terrible redness and wanted something calm to for my sensitive skin. I did try the dermalogica calm water gel first - which made my skin redness worse. I use this morning and evening and have bought at least 6 tubes. My skin loves it and I love the ingredients. I won't use anything else. Normal/Oily t-zone. Hormonal/Cystic Acne. Dehydrated/Sensitive skin.

My skin: oily, not sensitive, not very acne-prone but sometimes get 1-2 pimples if I haven't washed my face or changed my pillowcase after 2ish days. (Nasty, I know, but I'm home most of the time now because of covid.) I've gone through two tubes of this cleanser because it's consistently good for my skin. I think its pretty basic as a cleanser but that can be good depending on your skin needs. My face feels clean and supple after every wash--not stripping at all. And I mean, like, really supple. I use a salicylic cleanser for my PM routine but will use this one if I plan to use TO mask that night. The smell was weird at first but you get used to it (and my sister says it smells exactly like her tea tree oil. I wouldn't know but yeah). Lastly, amazing value: one tube lasts me at least four months because you really don't need a lot for it to foam up (I squeeze out half to 3/4 an inch per use). Totally recommend, even for sensitive peepers.

I got this cleanser in the acne sampler pack and I was really hesitant to try it. I'm 25 and have always had acne. I have very sensitive, oily-combination skin. I was using only CeraVe products and while they did fine it was not preventing breakouts. This is the first cleanser I've used where I haven't had a single new breakout in the week I've used it. It does leave my skin feeling just a smidge tight if I let my skin dry before applying toner, but my skin seems to love it. It is foaming but it is pretty gentle, I don't feel a tingle or sting. There is that tea tree oil scent but it does not linger. Buying the full sized bottle now!!
